items.name: button-shine
items.title: Button Shine
items.description: Primary action button with a sweep-highlight hover effect, press feedback, and 44px touch target. Exact-property transitions and reduced-motion safe.

items.name: stat-ticker
items.title: Stat Ticker
items.description: Animated count-up statistic with label. Counts once on scroll into view using IntersectionObserver; uses tabular-nums to prevent layout shift.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing Toggle
items.description: Three-tier pricing table with an accessible monthly/annual switch. Concentric border radii, tabular prices, keyboard-operable switch.

items.name: hero-spotlight
items.title: Hero Spotlight
items.description: Landing hero with a cursor-following spotlight and gradient mesh. Writes pointer position to CSS variables so paint stays on the compositor with no re-render.

items.name: pricing-ladder
items.title: Pricing Ladder
items.description: Four-rung value ladder with anchor ordering, decoy highlighting, percentage discounts and a checkout order bump. Applies anchoring, the decoy effect, the rule of 100, charm pricing and loss-aversion framing. tabular-nums keeps prices stable.

items.name: navbar-sticky
items.title: Navbar Sticky
items.description: Header that gains a blurred surface after scroll. Fixed height so there is no layout shift; backdrop blur only past a threshold so first paint stays cheap.

items.name: footer-columns
items.title: Footer Columns
items.description: Multi-column footer with a separated legal bar. Hover states on links, uppercase column headings.

items.name: testimonial-wall
items.title: Testimonial Wall
items.description: CSS-columns masonry of quote cards. No JS layout, no stagger animation, text-pretty to avoid orphans.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: Infinite marquee of wordmarks. Transform-only animation, seamless duplicate track, pauses on hover and disables under reduced motion.

items.name: feature-bento
items.title: Feature Bento
items.description: Asymmetric feature grid with deliberate spans. Concentric radii and hover elevation.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: CTA Band
items.description: Full-width closing call to action with a radial gradient wash and balanced headline.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ Accordion
items.description: Accessible disclosure list with single-open behaviour. Animates height via the grid-rows technique without measuring; aria-expanded wired.

items.name: marquee-text
items.title: Marquee Text
items.description: Large scrolling headline strip. Two rows can run in opposite directions; pauses on hover, disabled for reduced motion.

items.name: tabs-underline
items.title: Tabs Underline
items.description: Keyboard-navigable tabs with a sliding underline. Roving tabindex, arrow-key support, aria-selected and aria-controls wired.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Overlapping avatars with a +N overflow chip. Concentric ring uses the surface colour so overlaps read on any background.

items.name: bento-gallery
items.title: Bento Gallery
items.description: Image bento grid with lazy loading and hover zoom. Subtle outline keeps images from bleeding into the surface.

items.name: stats-grid
items.title: Stats Grid
items.description: Divided metric row with responsive dividers. tabular-nums keeps figures from shifting.

items.name: feature-split
items.title: Feature Split
items.description: Alternating two-column feature section with an optional bullet list and media slot.

items.name: integrations-grid
items.title: Integrations Grid
items.description: Dense logo tile grid for integration lists. Hover state via border and background only.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact Form
items.description: Labelled form with inline validation. Labels always visible, 44px targets, errors tied via aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
